description: This file defines the BlobReporter class, a test report generator that creates ZIP reports with metadata, attachments, and logs for Playwright tests.

classes.name: BlobReporter
classes.description: A class that generates ZIP reports for Playwright test results, including metadata, attachments, and logs.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the BlobReporter with options, validates filename extension, and generates a GUID salt.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets up report metadata including version, user agent, and shard info.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the report by creating a ZIP file with metadata, attachments, and logs.

methods.name: _prepareOutputFile
methods.description: Prepares the output file path, removing old reports if necessary, and creates directories.

methods.name: _defaultReportName
methods.description: Generates a default report filename based on command hash and shard info.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes test attachments, adding a SHA1 hash and storing attachment info for ZIP inclusion.
